overview_description.description:
We're building a company that improves your relationship with brands. 

We've all been there — a sales associate asks for your email address but you politely respond "no thanks." You wanted the receipt but know that you'll get emails weekly for the rest of your life. With Margin, apply filters to those incoming emails so you only get the ones you really want in your usual inbox.
